why: I checked each check's PASS and FAIL conditions against the words of its expect line. Check 3 is fine: "mentions `--shout` and says what it does" is a fair reading of "documents --shout". The extra checks for a flag after the name, a missing name and tests are correctly under Advisory. Check 1 breaks the criterion. Its expect line only says the command "prints the greeting in upper case", but PASS requires "each command exits 0" and FAIL includes "a non-zero exit". Nothing in the words requires an exit code. Check 2's PASS also requires the "exit code" to match the base, which goes beyond "the output is unchanged". Check 4 is also a problem: it judges the PR on whether the pages.yml workflow still publishes docs/, a stand-in the expect line never mentions. All of these belong under Advisory, not in PASS or FAIL.
